info.title: 0R10N15-8374 - Governed Crossing Evaluation
info.description: Governed evaluation at a signing boundary, operated by StegVerse LLC. Each crossing is a manifest-governed packet evaluated against the admitted scope; every crossing, ALLOW or NON-ALLOW, produces a matched receipt pair, and the fee is paid either way. Posted tiers: receipt-only $0.0005; full-evaluation $0.015 (select via the body's tier field; defaults to receipt-only). The posted tiers are the governance fee; settlement gas is charged additionally on each crossing, quoted live at challenge time, and the 402 challenge amount is the total authorized (governance fee + settlement charge). Payment: x402 exact scheme, USDC on Base, to the recipient published in the service's authenticated offer; authorizations are accepted only for that recipient. Patent pending: U.S. Application No. 64/198,910.

post.summary: Submit a governed crossing for evaluation

tier.description: Posted fee tier for this crossing (see the offer document); defaults to receipt-only.

counterparty.description: Caller's declared identity for the crossing record.

action.description: The governed action requested at this crossing.

scope_ref.description: Reference to the admitted scope under which the action is requested.

sublane.description: Optional routing name (two uppercase alphanumeric characters, e.g. "AA"); receipts land on that sub-lane's chain under 8374's one identity.

200.description: Crossing evaluated; the response carries the disposition, the receipt pair identifiers, and the caller's retention bundle (BUILD-Q-44).

402.description: Payment required (x402): see the challenge body's accepts[] and extensions.bazaar.

422.description: Crossing refused (NON-ALLOW); the response carries the refusal receipt pair.
